segments.text: There is a question people are embarrassed to ask first. Ask it first. Who pays?
There are two routes. You pay us directly, or your insurer pays on your behalf.
Either way, the money started as yours.
An insurance payout is not the insurer's goodwill. It is the cover you have already paid for, in every premium.
That makes you the policy holder, and our client. Not the insurer.
You are entitled to see the scope, the quote, and what is being claimed on your behalf.
We work for you. Your insurer is who the invoice goes to, not who we answer to.
Ask us for anything we send them. It is your claim.
